player_prompt.intro:
Yu bai obserim {N} hait vailua long arere.
Long kila hap yu mas typim [accept] long kisim vailua ya *klok*, o [continue] long skelim na lukim vailua ya bihain.
Sapos yu no kisim, bai yu kisim vailua ya finis.
Yu win (reward = 1) **tasol** sapos vailua yu kisim em i winim olgeta.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aksan yu mas i o [accept] o [continue].

outcome.summary: Yu akseptim value {value} long dra {draw_num}/{N}. Wanpela bes ol i stap {best}. {result}
